Title: API accepts no-photo confirmed discoveries that Web Gallery omits
Environment/Build: Deployed API v1.2.0/PostgreSQL and deployed Expo Web latest; 30-31 Aug 2026
Steps: 1. POST a discovery with species_id and location_label but no photo. 2. Repeat the request. 3. Confirm API progress/gallery counts. 4. Open the species Web Gallery. 5. Complete one normal UI discovery with a synthetic photo and reopen Gallery.
Expected: A confirmed discovery requires a valid photo, or all accepted observation types are represented consistently across API progress and Web Gallery.
Actual: DEP-API-17–20 accepted and counted no-photo observations. Web Gallery displayed only later photo-backed UI observations; API no-photo records were omitted.
Evidence: DEP-API-17; DEP-API-18; DEP-API-19; DEP-API-20; UI-11-card-gallery; UI-28-gallery-after-discovery; SUP-AC4-1-12-Fail; SUP-AC4-1-13-Fail
Owner/Target: Backend + frontend owners — align validation and gallery contract
Notes: Normal UI enforces photo selection. The defect is a cross-layer/API validation and representation inconsistency.
